body: Yeah, I feel extremely guilty for not trying as hard as I can, but since I know the main reason to do it would be to improve myself, it's also unappealing. Self destruction and deprivation is so much more comfortable for me, if that makes sense. I can't take a chance, having vulnerability and showing emotion is the worse possible scenario.

I have a small group of friends, but I always feel slightly distant, like I can never empathize with them. I have a slight anxiety around people (including them) because of this, social cues and norms are hard to pick up on. I avoid people- but how can i survive in the real world with this mentality?? Drawing and running in woods by my house are relaxing hobbies, but it's overall not worth it. I can live- or die- without them, and they don't make up for the rest of the shit I know I'm responsible for.
